response.sql: WITH sex_averages AS (SELECT p.SEX, AVG(CAST(l.CPK AS REAL) / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS ratio_average FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.CPK IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT <> 0 GROUP BY p.SEX), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(ratio_average) AS value FROM sex_averages), above_first AS (SELECT s.SEX, s.ratio_average FROM sex_averages AS s CROSS JOIN first_mean AS f WHERE s.ratio_average > f.value), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(ratio_average) AS value FROM above_first) SELECT AVG(a.ratio_average) AS average_ratio, AVG(a.ratio_average - f.value) AS average_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(a.ratio_average - m.value) AS average_excess_over_second_mean FROM above_first AS a CROSS JOIN first_mean AS f CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m WHERE a.ratio_average > m.value

assumptions.assumption: A zero GPT makes the ratio undefined, so that test is excluded.
